changelog_text:
## Changes

- Mark all white and carbon fairing halves as `Radial` so the editor prevents new surface attachments to halves that jettison. Mount payloads and other hardware on the fairing base or the stage.
- Keep the existing part IDs, connector order and fairing joints. The shared 2 m fairing files are identical in Prisma 1.2.0 and Fairings 1.0.1.

## Compatibility

Validated against KSA build version **2026.11.16.5901**.

## Installation

Extract into `Documents\My Games\Kitten Space Agency\mods\PurrlineFairings\`. No mod loader is needed.

listing.name: Fairings by Purrline Rocketworks
listing.abstract: Payload fairings in 2 m and 3 m with three lengths each, white or black carbon, with bases for 2 m and 3 m stacks and hammerhead bases from 2 m to 3 m and from 3 m to 4 m.
listing.description:
![The fairing family in orbit](ksa-image:family)

**Fairings** is a set of payload fairings for Kitten Space Agency, from the fictional rocket maker **Purrline Rocketworks**. The sizes fit the stock 2 m and 3 m tanks, and the hammerhead bases put a wider fairing on a narrower stage.

## Parts

- **Fairing Half 2 m Short**, **Medium** and **Long**: fairing halves of 4.55, 6.10 and 7.65 m; place two.
- **Fairing Half 3 m Short**, **Medium** and **Long**: fairing halves of 7.60, 9.15 and 12.25 m.
- **Fairing Base 2 m** and **Fairing Base 3 m**: base rings with a payload adapter.
- **Fairing Base 2 m to 3 m** and **Fairing Base 3 m to 4 m**: hammerhead bases; a 3 m half at scale 1.33 makes the 4 m fairing.

Every half and both hammerhead bases come in white paint or black carbon (press V on a placed part). The halves fall away to show their quilted acoustic blankets. Attach radial equipment to the payload or base, because the editor no longer snaps it to a fairing half. With the scale tool of the editor the 2 m set also makes a 1 m fairing.

![All parts and both looks](ksa-image:all-parts)

![The acoustic blanket inside the halves](ksa-image:interior)

![The hammerhead bases](ksa-image:hammerheads)

## Prisma

The 2 m medium half and the 2 m base were the fairing of Prisma by Purrline Rocketworks 1.0.0 and keep their part Ids, so saved Prisma vehicles load with their fairing. Prisma 1.1.0 and later contain the same 2 m fairing, so you can install Prisma and Fairings together, in any mod order. Update Prisma to 1.1.0 or later before you enable Fairings: Prisma 1.0.0 contains the same fairing parts in an older form, and with both enabled the fairing does not load.

## Install

- Borea: install Fairings from the content list.
- By hand: copy `PurrlineFairings` from the release zip into `Documents/My Games/Kitten Space Agency/mods/` and enable it.

To remove the mod, delete its folder. Vehicles with its parts do not load without it.

Validated against KSA build 2026.11.16.5901.
